messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 3 May, 07:00–11:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (NetDocs) will be unavailable this Saturday 3 May between 07:00 and 11:00 for a scheduled upgrade. Please save and check in any open documents before Friday close. Email will not be affected.

IT Helpdesk
